additions.name: KDDI Osaka Sakai Existing Operations

locator.precision: Approximate analyst-selected point at the KDDI-identified converted factory property within the historical Green Front Sakai complex, rounded to four decimals and used only as a campus locator. It is not an operator-published pin, surveyed centroid, parcel boundary, occupied server-room footprint or marker for the whole historical Sharp complex.
locator.identity_review: The January KDDI release and Spark Journal article explicitly name Osaka Sakai Data Center and show the same KDDI-branded former factory block from different angles. The roof cooling spine, eastern office bars, north waterfront road, southern service corridor and western open strip match the Esri image. CBRE, the acquisition adviser, identifies the acquired property as the former color-filter production facility, with about 33,000 square metres of land and 57,000 square metres of floor area. Sharp confirms the April 4, 2025 transfer to KDDI. SoftBank separately contracted for about 450,000 square metres of land and 840,000 square metres of buildings; its project is not this KDDI property.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Imagery acquisition date and absolute positional accuracy are unestablished. Roof parallax, historical changes and manual matching introduce unquantified uncertainty. Pixel resolution and decimal places are not measured ground accuracy.

scoped_project_details.capacity_note: No area, capex, GPU count, rack rating or whole Sharp-site capacity is converted or assigned to this project.

status.summary: The July 28 operator release describes the named Osaka Sakai center as providing Gemini on GDC. Select that contemporaneous service assertion as confirmation of existing operations. July 28 is publication, not the facility opening date or delivery date of the newly announced startup program.

additions.distinctness_review: All 414 baseline sites, 440 projects, original 231 source records and their identity mapping screened across KDDI, Telehouse and Sakai aliases. Existing SoftBank Sakai is a different acquisition within the former Sharp complex; property sizes, participant acquisition accounts and KDDI-labelled exterior photos distinguish it. SoftBank inherited neighbourhood point is not an exact parcel and is not used to locate KDDI. Root independently reviewed the operator photos and georeferenced imagery.
additions.successor_review: Select the July 28 current service assertion, not the newly announced startup program delivery. April 30 confirms trial service began March 27 and full commercial service targets 2027. Later August 5 consortium provision and September 18 APN/robot experiments contain prospective execution language; no stronger completed-work or capacity inference selected.
